episodes.title: Providence
episodes.summary: Brian Fraser and Ellen MacKenzie meet for the first time and are struck by their strong connection.

episodes.title: S.W.A.K. (Sealed with a Kiss)
episodes.summary: While Henry fights in WWI and Julia works in London, their love story unfolds through their letters.

episodes.title: School of the Moon
episodes.summary: As the oath-taking ceremony to determine who will be Laird of Clan MacKenzie approaches, Ellen hatches a new plan to protect herself and her family; Julia is forced to make an impossible choice.

episodes.title: A Soldier's Heart
episodes.summary: Henry tackles a challenging assignment in his own way. Ellen learns some concerning information about the family into which she's expected to marry.

episodes.title: Needfire
episodes.summary: Ellen and Brian attend Beltane, a festival to celebrate the coming of summer, where sins are burned away by the needfire; Henry struggles to hold onto his hope and Julia loses allies when secrets come out.

episodes.title: Birthright
episodes.summary: Henry continues to look for Julia until a new discovery threatens to end his search.

episodes.title: Luceo Non Uro
episodes.summary: Lord Lovat goes to extreme lengths to fulfill a prophecy; Dougal attends a clandestine meeting that could spell political disaster for the MacKenzies.

episodes.title: A Virtuous Woman
episodes.summary: At the request of the Grants, Ellen undergoes a test to prove her worthiness to marry into the clan.

episodes.title: Braemar
episodes.summary: All the highland clans attend the Earl of Mar's annual hunting event at Braemar Castle, where the Earl makes an inflammatory proclamation.

episodes.title: Something Borrowed
episodes.summary: Ellen prepares for her wedding day, while Julia attempts her escape.

episodes.title: Remembrance Day
episodes.summary: The fiery crosses have been lit across the Highlands. The call to arms brings friends and enemies home and the Jacobite Rebellion begins in earnest.

episodes.title: The Veil of Time
episodes.summary: Brian and Ellen help their clans prepare for the coming rebellion, with varying levels of success. Julia and Henry learn more about the stones at Craigh na Dun from unexpected sources.

episodes.title: Rabbits Don't Swim
episodes.summary: Julia welcomes a new member of staff to Leathers and learns unsettling news. Brian and Dougal train their men for battle. Ellen calls on lessons from her father and uses her wit to defend her family and her clan.
